## Hello

I'm **Associate Director, Biostatistics at Pfizer** in Chennai, on the Data
Science & Analytics India leadership team, where I lead a team of statisticians
across global Inflammation & Immunology development programs.

Before Pfizer I was a primary statistical reviewer at the **FDA's Oncology Center
of Excellence**. That mix — regulatory judgement on one side, development strategy
on the other — is what I bring to the work.

## Oncology

My current role sits in Inflammation & Immunology, but oncology is where I built
my regulatory foundation.

At the FDA I reviewed NDA and BLA submissions across multiple oncology
indications — gastric and gastroesophageal cancers, cholangiocarcinoma, and other
solid tumors, alongside an oncology biosimilar and a supportive-care program —
and led sponsor–agency interactions and labelling negotiations.

At Pfizer I served as trial statistician on targeted-therapy programs in
non-small cell lung cancer and melanoma.

## Innovation & research

I'm most interested in the methods that change what a development program can
actually learn:

- **Real-world evidence and target trial emulation** — building enterprise
  capability at Pfizer to support next-generation evidence generation
- **External-control cohorts** — contributed to one of the FDA's early evaluations
  of non-traditional evidence, through the review of a pediatric neuroblastoma program
- **Endpoint consolidation and real-time trial monitoring** across development programs
- **Empirical Bayes and adaptive design**, carried over from my PhD at the
  University of Florida

Fifteen peer-reviewed papers to date — the list is on
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=9LJsXtMAAAAJ&hl=en)
and in my [CV](cv.qmd).
